item.title: Police to prosecute four suspected motorcycle thieves in Ondo
item.description: Ondo State Police Command has confirmed that four suspected members of a motorcycle theft ring will be arraigned in court following their arrest and the recovery of a stolen motorcycle. The development is linked to an earlier police operation that led to the interception of two stolen motorcycles in the state. In a statement issued […] Police to prosecute four suspected motorcycle thieves in Ondo

item.title: Nigerian Govt reveals main beneficiaries of new tax reforms
item.description: The Nigeria Revenue Service, NRS, has disclosed the main beneficiaries of the new tax law instituted by President Bola Tinubu. Speaking in an interview on Sunday on Arise Television monitored by DAILY POST, the Executive Chairman of the Nigeria Revenue Service, Zacchaeus Adedeji, said the poor are the main beneficiaries of the new tax reforms. item.title: Venezuela: International law only made for poor countries – Shehu Sani
item.description: Former Kaduna Central Senator, Shehu Sani, says international law is only for the weak and the poor countries. In a post on his verified X handle on Sunday, Sani said that the law is for countries without nuclear weapons, alleging that super powers and their cronies are insulated from the law. item.title: Northern governors condemn Niger market attack, mourn victims of Yobe boat mishap
item.description: The Northern States Governors Forum has condemned the deadly bandit attack on a market in Niger State and expressed deep sorrow over a separate boat accident in Yobe State that claimed several lives. item.title: AFCON: Morocco’s Brahim Díaz makes history after scoring against Tanzania
item.description: Morocco international, Brahim Diaz, on Sunday made history after scoring a goal in his side’s 2026 Africa Cup of Nations, AFCON, Round of 16 win against Tanzania. A second-half goal from Diaz ensured the host nation defeated Tanzania 1-0 to qualify for the AFCON quarter finals stage. item.title: ADC gains 5,000 members in Abia after Peter Obi’s entrance
item.description: The African Democratic Congress, ADC, on Saturday, received 5,000 members in Abia State, barely one week after the former presidential candidate of the Labour Party, Mr. Peter Obi joined the party. item.title: BREAKING: NNPCL reduces fuel price again
item.description: The Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited, NNPCL, has again reduced its premium motor spirit price. DAILY POST correspondent, who went round Abuja on Monday morning, gathered that NNPCL retail outlets have reduced their fuel price to N815 per liter, down from N835. This means that the NNPCL filling stations cut their price by N20. The […] BREAKING: NNPCL reduces fuel price again

item.title: NAF announces DSSC 34 enlistment interview dates for shortlisted candidates
item.description: The Nigerian Air Force, NAF, has officially released the schedule for the Direct Short Service Commission, DSSC, 34 enlistment interviews for candidates who successfully made the shortlist. The announcement, made on Sunday via the Air Force’s official X account, signals the next stage of the recruitment process for applicants seeking commission through the DSSC 34/2025 […] NAF announces DSSC 34 enlistment interview dates for shortlisted candidates

item.title: Bandits attack Katsina community, abduct more than 20 villagers
item.description: Bandits have attacked Unguwar Daudu community in Dukke ward, Funtua local government area of Katsina State, injuring two residents and abducting at least 20 others. The development was disclosed on Monday by Bakatsine, a conflict and crisis journalist who reports on insecurity in Nigeria’s northwest.
